title: Radial progress: Custom size and custom thickness (daisyUI)
notes:
Radial progress can be used to show the progress of a task or to show the passing of time.

Needs daisyUI installed (npm i -D daisyui, then @plugin "daisyui" in your CSS).

Original file: https://github.com/saadeghi/daisyui/blob/master/packages/docs/src/routes/(routes)/components/radial-progress/+page.md
